name: Witcher Online
author: brainshead@gmail.com
description:
Witcher Online Server using https://www.nexusmods.com/witcher3/mods/11590.
Witcher Online is a mod that adds multiplayer to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, turning your single player experience into an MMO experience. Join servers to play with your friends, customize your character using Custom Player Characters and relax in taverns using Chill Out. Chat with strangers and perform emotes to roleplay with other players. Complete quests and play through the entire story together. Play Gwent and join parties with other players. The focus of this mod is to allow you to see other players on their adventure exploring throughout the world. A non-pirated copy of the latest version of Next Gen, Steam or GOG version 4.04+ is required.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "========================================="
echo " Witcher Online Server Installer"
echo "========================================="

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y \
    curl \
    jq \
    unzip \
    p7zip-full \
    ca-certificates

cd /mnt/server

GAME_DOMAIN="${GAME_DOMAIN:-witcher3}"
MOD_ID="${MOD_ID:-11590}"

DOWNLOAD_URL=""
ARCHIVE=""
DOWNLOADED_ARCHIVE=false

#############################################
# Check for manually uploaded archive
#############################################

echo "Checking for manually uploaded archive..."

EXISTING_ARCHIVE=$(find . \
    -maxdepth 1 \
    \( -iname "*.zip" -o -iname "*.7z" -o -iname "*.rar" \) \
    | head -n 1)

if [ -n "${EXISTING_ARCHIVE}" ]; then

    ARCHIVE=$(basename "${EXISTING_ARCHIVE}")

    echo "Found archive:"
    echo "  ${ARCHIVE}"
    echo "Skipping Nexus download."

else

    #############################################
    # Validate Nexus API key
    #############################################

    if [ -z "${NEXUS_API_KEY}" ]; then
        echo
        echo "ERROR: No manually uploaded archive found."
        echo "Please either:"
        echo " - Upload the Witcher Online Server archive"
        echo " - Provide a Nexus Mods Premium API key"
        exit 1
    fi

fi

#############################################
# Backup existing installation
#############################################

echo
echo "Backing up existing installation..."

BACKUP_DIR=".installer-backups/$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S)"
mkdir -p "${BACKUP_DIR}"

for FILE in \
    WitcherServer.jar \
    run.bat \
    readme.txt \
    server.properties \
    banned-players.json \
    whitelisted-players.json
do
    [ -f "${FILE}" ] && mv "${FILE}" "${BACKUP_DIR}/"
done

#############################################
# Nexus download (only if no archive exists)
#############################################

if [ -z "${ARCHIVE}" ]; then

    echo
    echo "Retrieving Nexus file list..."

    FILES_JSON=$(curl -fsSL \
        -H "apikey: ${NEXUS_API_KEY}" \
        -H "accept: application/json" \
        -H "User-Agent: WitcherOnlineServerInstaller/1.0" \
        "https://api.nexusmods.com/v1/games/${GAME_DOMAIN}/mods/${MOD_ID}/files.json")

    FILE_ID=$(echo "${FILES_JSON}" | jq -r '
        .files
        | map(select(.name | test("^Witcher Online Server"; "i")))
        | sort_by(.uploaded_timestamp)
        | last
        | .file_id
    ')

    if [ -z "${FILE_ID}" ] || [ "${FILE_ID}" = "null" ]; then
        echo
        echo "ERROR: Unable to determine latest Witcher Online Server file."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Using Nexus File ID: ${FILE_ID}"

    echo
    echo "Requesting Nexus download link..."

    DOWNLOAD_RESPONSE=$(curl -sSL \
        -H "apikey: ${NEXUS_API_KEY}" \
        -H "accept: application/json" \
        -H "User-Agent: WitcherOnlineServerInstaller/1.0" \
        "https://api.nexusmods.com/v1/games/${GAME_DOMAIN}/mods/${MOD_ID}/files/${FILE_ID}/download_link.json")

    if echo "${DOWNLOAD_RESPONSE}" | jq -e 'type=="array"' >/dev/null 2>&1; then

        DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo "${DOWNLOAD_RESPONSE}" | jq -r '.[0].URI')

    else

        echo
        echo "Automatic download unavailable."

        if echo "${DOWNLOAD_RESPONSE}" | grep -qi "premium"; then
            echo "Reason: Nexus Mods Premium is required for API downloads."
        else
            echo "${DOWNLOAD_RESPONSE}"
        fi

        exit 1

    fi

    ARCHIVE=$(basename "${DOWNLOAD_URL%%\?*}")

    [ -z "${ARCHIVE}" ] && ARCHIVE="download"

    echo
    echo "Downloading ${ARCHIVE}..."

    curl \
        --fail \
        --location \
        --progress-bar \
        "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" \
        -o "${ARCHIVE}"

    DOWNLOADED_ARCHIVE=true

fi

#############################################
# Extract archive
#############################################

echo
echo "Extracting ${ARCHIVE}..."

case "${ARCHIVE,,}" in
    *.zip)
        unzip -o "${ARCHIVE}"
        ;;
    *.7z|*.rar)
        7z x "${ARCHIVE}" -y
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Unknown archive type, trying 7-Zip..."
        7z x "${ARCHIVE}" -y
        ;;
esac

#############################################
# Cleanup downloaded archive
#############################################

if [ "${DOWNLOADED_ARCHIVE}" = true ]; then
    rm -f "${ARCHIVE}"
fi

#############################################
# Validate installation
#############################################

if [ ! -f "WitcherServer.jar" ]; then

    echo
    echo "ERROR: WitcherServer.jar was not found after extraction."
    echo

    find . -maxdepth 2 -type f

    exit 1

fi

#############################################
# Finished
#############################################

echo
echo "========================================="
echo " Installation Complete"
echo "========================================="
echo
